name: Blue crab
desc: An omnivore that eats clams, mussels, oysters, worms, small fish and eelgrass, and also scavenges. Striped bass are among its predators.
about: Callinectes sapidus, commonly known as the blue crab, Atlantic blue crab, or, regionally, the Maryland blue crab, is a species of crab native to the waters of the western Atlantic Ocean and the Gulf…
